evidence: BIS Product Manual PM/IS 14220/3 (July 2024) Clause 2 & Annex B specifies IS 9283 for motor requirements and submersible electrical test gear.
IS 14220:2018 Clause 9.1 mandates pump test verification of rate of flow, total head, and overall efficiency in accordance with IS 11346.
IS 14220:2018 Clause 13.1 references IS 5120 for casing hydrostatic pressure testing procedures and gasket tolerances.
Official BIS standard revision note on IS 14220:2018 declares it as the First Revision superseding IS 14220:1994.
IS 8034:2018 Clause 6.1 stipulates that submersible motors driving the borehole pumps shall conform to IS 9283.
IS 8034:2018 Clause 10 & PM/IS 8034 mandate hydraulic performance acceptance tests as per IS 11346.
IS 8034:2018 references IS 5120 for general technical requirements, casing pressure testing, and allowable materials.
IS 9283:2024 Sectional Committee ETD 15 references IS 12615 for efficiency classification and IE code alignment.
IS 9079:2018 Clause 9 mandates performance and duty point verification in accordance with IS 11346.
IS 9079:2018 Clause 12 references IS 5120 for hydrostatic casing test methodology.
IS 6595 (Part 1):2018 specifies acceptance testing for agricultural centrifugal pumps as per IS 11346.
IS 6595 (Part 1):2018 references IS 5120 for general rotodynamic pump specifications.
IS 8472:2019 Clause 14 specifies flow and head test measurement procedures following IS 11346.
Both standards fall under BIS Sectional Committee MED 20 (Pumps) and govern clear cold water submersible pumping technologies.
